newsitem.title: USA: NationsBank to expand mutual funds family.
newsitem.headline: NationsBank to expand mutual funds family.

text.p: NationsBank Corp. was preparing to extend its family of mutual funds that would enable investors to select from hundreds of funds, a spokeswoman said on Thursday.
The expansion, due next month, would have some 350 funds from 20 companies, she said.
"We're planning on having this up and running in October," said Katy Pike of NationsBank.
Currently the bank has $18.5 billion in mutual fund assets but the amount was due to increase $5.5 billion once it completes the purchase of Boatmen's Bancshares Inc.
NationsBank announced earlier this month that it would pay $9.46 billion for Boatmen's, a St. Louis-based franchise.
The acquisiton, if it passes federal regulation, would launch NationsBank into the Midwest market. Shareholders of both companies are due to vote on the deal in December.
